aiVerification.summary: Comparable supplier-change evidence exists, but the draft has incorrect grouping and several misparsed measurement outcomes.
issues: Primary factor should be GES Trading CD material supplier vs normal Ralon, with overbroad change domains removed.
Separate VP/CD outcome omits the normal comparison row.
FO outcomes are misparsed; row values are treated as sample indices instead of FO measurements.
NTI SPL/THD/IMP outcomes cite header rows only, not sufficient data rows.
Review title is taken from Decap NG instead of the main supplier test report.
correctionPlan: Rename review using the Report sheet title and purpose.
Normalize baseline to Normal Supplier Ralon and changed condition to New Supplier GES Trading.
Add Report!28 to Separate VP/CD and judge against Report!26.
Rebuild FO as one measurement comparison using rows 5-15, especially averages.
Remove or mark NTI SPL/THD/IMP as unverified unless citeable data rows are added.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Main Report citations are sufficient; FO/NTI citations are not sufficient as drafted.
